text:
sasha: Hey team — customer wants a POC where guests get time-limited access and can't hit dedicated pools. What's safest, hosted API keys with per-route scoping or ephemeral workspace invites?
kevin: For speed I'd do hosted ephemeral keys scoped to a single project + route. Easier than provisioning Dedicated for each guest. Can do Dedicated read-only if they need throughput testing.
maria: Security note: they require invite TTL <= 7 days and no ability to create keys. We should use invite role that forbids key generation and limits to `poc-viewer` permissions.
jordan: Agree. We have an internal invite flow flag `guest_ttl_hours` — default 168h. For this POC set to 72h and enforce `allow_key_create: false` at role level.
sasha: Can someone draft the step-by-step for the customer? They want to self-onboard 4 engineers and 2 product folks.
kevin: Steps I usually send:
- Create workspace for POC
- Create role `poc-guest` (permissions: read-models, invoke-hosted, no-key-create)
- Invite emails with TTL 72h
- Provide ephemeral keys scoped to route `/v1/generate` only
- Optionally give one service account for CI with restricted rate limits
maria: Also add IP allowlist on their side for private deployments and request KMS audit logs for Dedicated/Private. For hosted keys, we recommend short-lived tokens + monitoring.
sasha: Here's a quick example curl to mint a scoped ephemeral token (internal only):
```
POST https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/ephemeral_tokens
payload: {"workspace":"acme-poc","scopes":["/v1/generate"],"ttl":259200}
```
kevin: Pricing question from the AE: if they need a single Dedicated pool for 2 weeks for load tests, should we bill non-prorated reserved or on-demand? 
jordan: Use Dedicated burst + on-demand for short tests; avoids committing monthly. We'll estimate 48 GPU-hours and pass the cost estimate to finance.
sasha: Maria, they also asked about security questionnaire section on RBAC (SaaS): specifically who has admin rights and where audit logs live.
maria: Admins = customer SSO org owners + pax from our CSM team as `support-read`. Audit logs stored in customer tenant for Private; for Hosted we provide export to their SIEM via webhook/S3 (retention options available). I'll attach language they can paste into the questionnaire.
sasha: Great — action items:
- jordan: create `poc-guest` role & set default TTL to 72h (owner)
- kevin: send cost estimate for 48 GPU-hours and a Dedicated burst plan
- maria: paste RBAC + audit logging language for the questionnaire
- deploy-bot: create a ticket in POC workspace for invites
deploy-bot: Created ticket #POC-8042 in workspace `acme-poc` — assigned to jordan, kevin, maria :white_check_mark:
kevin: I'll loop in the customer and schedule a 30m handoff tomorrow morning. :calendar:
sasha: Thanks team — will follow up after the handoff. :thumbsup:
